test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph below shows the percentage distribution of the total expenditures of a company under various expense heads during 2016.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63222b828b946b01d9710716fbf37ea1f42e52014dc82e3f03965d4afb231ff2.png] 

If the expenditure on advertisement is ₹ 3.6 crore, then what is the difference (in ₹ crore) between the expenditure on salary and that on corporate social responsibility?
solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure on advertisement = ₹3.6 crore

Percentage of expenditure on advertisement = 12%

Total expenditure of the company = ₹30 crore (calculated from the advertisement expenditure)

**Formula used:**

Total Expenditure = (Expenditure on Advertisement / Percentage of Advertisement Expenditure) × 100
